method.ranking_basis: Source fidelity and requested coverage first, then useful scope and clarity; ties are allowed. Some preferences concern scope rather than factual correctness.
method.assessment_scope: Reviewer assessment labels are retained verbatim. Incomplete can mean missing requested content in a finished answer, or a native output-limit failure; native answer_complete and separate by-arm counts distinguish these. Each language packet has one judge, so label thresholds are not independently calibrated across judges.
method.material_issue_definition: Clearly identified factual/parsing/quotation errors and important omissions of requested content; this count is not an accuracy rate. Minor wording and interpretive cautions remain in notes.
method.reviewer_overlap: The Aramaic judge authored the frozen evaluation. Other judges had participated in training-example authoring or review; all read evaluation questions only after training examples were frozen. Three judges produced separate case reviews, not independent duplicate ratings of every answer.
method.output_limit_scope: The extractor retains completed native messages. The three truncated generations have no retained final text; generated token IDs were hashed rather than saved. Actual unfinished content, repetition, and analysis-only generation cannot be established.
